CustomField.description: Whether this automation runs when the rollup engine updates a person or organization's totals. Only rows marked this way, and those that always run, run on such an update; the rest have nothing to do when only totals change (D-200 P10). Field history is kept either way.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this when the automation reads rollup totals, so it must run when the rollup engine changes them.
CustomField.label: Runs On Rollup Writes
